about: The heap cost of the parser tree (Node) and of the Arena for the 84 S2 parse inputs, and a flat tree estimate. Counts of scripts/s3b/tree-cost: blocks and asked bytes. parse: the allocations of Parser::root_parse. node_tree: what a clone of the tree keeps. arena: what Arena::from_node keeps.
command: uv run --frozen --project harness python scripts/s3b/core_design.py measure
